product_metadata.title: Prepac Space-Saving 36 Pair Shoe Storage Cabinet With Cubbies, 13"D x 23.5"W x 72.5"H, Espresso
features: SHOE STORAGE CABINET: Clean, simple and narrow design with an Espresso laminate finish provides 36 equally-sized cube shelves to provide reliable and organized shoe storage in your entryway, laundry room, garage or mudroom
EFFICIENT CUBBY SYSTEM: Each cubby has enough room to fit most pairs of standard shoes, and can also double as storage for your accessories, keys, wallets, mail and more
MANUFACTURED IN NORTH AMERICA: Made from durable non-toxic, CARB-2 compliant laminated composite woods
SIMPLE ASSEMBLY: Durable high-quality storage cabinet ships flat-packed and ready to assemble with the included instructional booklet
CLEAR CLUTTER: Measuring 13"D x 23.5"W x 72.5"H total, this expansive storage solution provides 36 cubbies measuring 11.75" D x 7"W x 5.25"H allowing you to clear cumbersome shoes out of your path
description: Clear the footwear clutter around your home with the Prepac Space-Saving Shoe Storage Cabinet. Clean symmetry and an Espresso laminate finish make this handy storage solution an aesthetic alternative to the traditional shoe rack. Simple in design yet functional in use, this impressive cabinet features 36 generously sized cubbies capable of accommodating most standard shoe styles. Fit this shoe storage cabinet into a narrow entryway or by the door in your mudroom to eliminate the hassle of tripping over loose shoes scattered across the floor. The generous cubbies can even be used as a perch for your keys, mail, and additional accessories such as hats or scarves. This expansive shelf with cubbies ships flat packed and ready to assemble with the aid of the included instruction booklet. Rest easy knowing that this organization unit is built to last, made with non-toxic, CARB-2 compliant laminated composite woods. Measuring 13"D x 23.5"W x 72.5"H total with 36 cubbies measuring 11.75" D x 7"W x 5.25"H, you will be able to maximize your storage without minimizing your room space. Pair this versatile cabinet with other furniture pieces from the Space-Saving collection to create an efficient and uniform closet system.
